assets.defect_engineered: shot into the low sun; the sky is clipped to flat paper-white with NO highlight data behind it, so a highlight-recovery call returns a picture indistinguishable from the input while reporting success — one of the two checkpoint-2 unrecoverable frames; strong warm WB, far from the house daylight.

second into-the-sun frame; sky clipped to paper with no recoverable highlight data (checkpoint-2), so pulling highlights changes nothing while reporting success; strong warm cast, far from the house daylight.

second windscreen frame: dashboard reflection plus an uneven polariser sky band requiring a confined correction rather than a global move (step 10); cool WB.
the best-lit, neutral reference frame the house daylight is built from (one white point, one contrast target); level, unclipped and no windscreen artifacts — carries no defect by design.

a phone photo of a printed sheet ON A WALL, not a flat scan, so a prompt naming 'the sheet' selects the paper and the tape rather than the drawn shapes; the ink runs close to the paper value in the shadowed bottom-right corner; and the YIELD glyph is an enclosed OUTLINE triangle whose open interior a background knockout cannot punch (it hands back a filled triangle) — forcing an ink-level selection, a trace and an injected viewBox rather than remove_background.

the retro-reflective sign face and the equally-bright overcast sky sit at nearly the same luminance along the TOP EDGE, and the post's shadow side reads close to the muted grey ground, so a one-call background knockout looks complete at preview scale but bites the sign's top edge and the shadowed side of the post — the bite only shows at full resolution against a colour (needs full-res inspection at step 12).

the printed guide reads as four tidy blocks per page, but the NUMBERED STEPS block is a fixed-measure text frame sized in 2019 around the SHORTEST scenario, with no auto-size, no thread and no overset flag exposed, so any longer 2026 record silently stops rendering at the trim edge with no warning in the merge response; the photograph well and the steps block also sit closer together in the artwork than the generous printed page suggests, and the file carries NO bleed.

eight scenario rows whose numbered step lists are WILDLY UNEVEN, from 3 lines (Hazard recognition) to 11 lines (Left turns across traffic), because two instructors wrote them separately with no measure; and the Roundabouts row names a Photo filename (milepost_roundabout_ref.jpg) that does NOT exist in anything the academy supplied (the real roundabout has to be licensed from Stock). Row order and count define the guide's pages; still_06 is reused across two rows as a real school would.
